items.title: Kylie Jenner walks Victoria's Secret in the $50 million Fantasy Bra
items.summary: Kylie Jenner made a surprise Victoria's Secret runway debut in the brand's first Fantasy Bra since 2018, a $50 million Jacob & Co. piece with 4,410 diamonds around a 75.54-carat yellow one, walking to JADE's "Angel of My Dreams" with Timothée Chalamet and Kris Jenner in the crowd. Pop Culture 2000s' clip got 140K likes, fans argued over whether a reality star should have gotten the bra instead of a veteran supermodel, TikTok filled with videos set to the song, and the two-and-a-half-year-old single jumped 4,300% on Spotify.
